backup.production_rule: One line of staff_pay_request_create_v2 changes (D-420): the attach-session test reads p_extras instead of v_extras, so a pay request that carries an extra no longer fails with extra_needs_a_clean; same signature, grants and lock order, no table or row changes. Plus s135b: service_role grants on staff_payout_change_notices written down as select + update(finance_sent_at, staff_sent_at), a no-op on production (live read 2026-11-24).
backup.notes: Apply after s134 is applied (or independently: it touches only staff_pay_request_create_v2, and the guard accepts only the s99 body). Restamp restore_point and verified_at with a fresh backup at apply time (scripts/migrations/fill-restore-point.mjs; the checker refuses one older than an hour). source.commit is the base commit the fix branched from; restamp it to the reviewed head at release time. No app push is needed: the Staff app already sends extras.

forward_verification.name: md5_staff_pay_request_create_v2
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(p.prosrc, chr(13), '')) = '2e29292fece7c5533395c663b29873a3' from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.staff_pay_request_create_v2(jsonb,uuid[],jsonb,jsonb,text)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: attach_test_reads_p_extras
forward_verification.query: select position('jsonb_array_length(p_extras) > 0' in p.prosrc) > 0 and position('if jsonb_array_length(v_extras) > 0 then' in p.prosrc) = 0 from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.staff_pay_request_create_v2(jsonb,uuid[],jsonb,jsonb,text)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: grants_unchanged_authenticated_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.staff_pay_request_create_v2(jsonb,uuid[],jsonb,jsonb,text)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.staff_pay_request_create_v2(jsonb,uuid[],jsonb,jsonb,text)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.staff_pay_request_create_v2(jsonb,uuid[],jsonb,jsonb,text)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: still_security_definer_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select p.prosecdef and exists (select 1 from unnest(p.proconfig) c where c in ('search_path=""', 'search_path=')) from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.staff_pay_request_create_v2(jsonb,uuid[],jsonb,jsonb,text)'::regprocedure

rollback.safe_until: Any time, losing nothing: the rollback restores the s99 body (md5 a95f98dedb25f139451f38b80032f9d6) and writes no data; requests and claims created while the fix was live stay as they are.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261204_s135_pay_extras_fix.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh; staff_pay_request_create_v2 must read md5 a95f98dedb25f139451f38b80032f9d6 again (extras are refused with extra_needs_a_clean again).

feature_flags.name: no_flag_the_app_follows_the_sql
feature_flags.required_state: None. Same signature and result shape; the only change is that a request with an extra now succeeds instead of returning extra_needs_a_clean.

compatibility.evidence: Not rehearsed on a restored backup yet; the pgTAP suites staff_pay_requests and s135_pay_extras_fix cover it in CI.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour, or restore_point / verified_at are still the placeholders
the migration guard raises 55000 (the live body is neither the s99 body nor this release)
the pgTAP suites staff_pay_requests, s99_staff_pay_ahead and s135_pay_extras_fix have not passed on this commit
the Opus 5.5 review of this SQL lane has not passed
